records.query: What are NVIDIA's competitive advantages in the data center market?
records.answer: NVIDIA's competitive advantages in the data center market include its unified underlying programmable architecture, large and growing number of developers and installed base, and significant investments in research and development, totaling over $76.7 billion since its inception [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #38]. The company's data center platform is focused on accelerating compute-intensive workloads, such as AI, data processing, graphics, robotics, and scientific computing, delivering superior total cost of ownership relative to conventional CPU-only approaches [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #41]. Additionally, NVIDIA's introduction of CUDA in 2006 opened the parallel processing capabilities of its GPU to a broad range of compute-intensive applications, paving the way for the emergence of modern AI [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #38]. The company's acquisition of Mellanox in 2020 expanded its offerings to include networking, enabling it to architect data center-scale computing platforms that can interconnect up to hundreds of thousands of compute nodes with high-performance networking [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #38]. Furthermore, NVIDIA's platforms address four large markets where its expertise is critical: Data Center, Gaming, Professional Visualization, and Automotive [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #41]. The company's strong engineering culture drives fast, yet harmonized, product and technology innovations in all dimensions of computing, including silicon, systems, networking, software, and algorithms [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #38]. NVIDIA also has a platform strategy, bringing together hardware, systems, software, algorithms, libraries, AI models, and training data sets, and services to create unique value for the markets it serves [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #38]. Its customers include all major public and private cloud providers, AI model makers, enterprises, and startups, and public sector entities [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #41]. Moreover, NVIDIA's introduction of new technologies, such as the NVIDIA Blackwell architecture and the NVIDIA Rubin platform, has enabled it to deliver market-leading performance and efficiency in processing cutting-edge generative AI and accelerated computing workloads [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #42] [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #5]. The NVIDIA Blackwell architecture excels at processing cutting-edge generative AI and accelerated computing workloads with market-leading performance and efficiency [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #42], while the NVIDIA Rubin platform is expected to deliver up to a 10x reduction in cost per token compared to Blackwell [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #42]. Overall, NVIDIA's competitive advantages in the data center market are driven by its innovative technologies, strong engineering culture, and strategic partnerships [NVDA_Fundamentals_20260519.txt, chunk #1] [NVDA_Fundamentals_20260508.txt, chunk #0].

records.answer:

此外，Apple Silicon 對公司的成本結構也有影響。由於 Apple 能夠控制自己的芯片設計和制造，公司可以減少對第三方供應商的依賴，從而降低成本和提高利润率 [AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5]. 根據公司公開的財務數據，Apple 的毛利率在過去幾年中不斷提高，達到 47.9% [AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5]。

總的來說，Apple Silicon 是 Apple 公司的一項重要戰略投資，旨在提高公司的競爭力、創新能力和經濟效益 [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #48]。

records.query: Tesla 面臨哪些主要競爭與監管風險？
records.answer:

特別地，美國最近宣布的貿易政策變化可能會對消費者支出和耐用消費品及相關服務的需求產生不利影響 [TSLA_10Q_202509.html, chunk #37]。此外，《減少通貨膨脹法案》（OBBBA）中某些條款，包括取消對電動汽車的稅收抵免，可能會影響電動汽車的消費者需求 [TSLA_10Q_202509.html, chunk #37]。

records.query: Apple 最新一份 10-K 年報的風險因素章節中，主要提到哪些風險？

Apple 最新一份 10-K 年報的風險因素章節中，主要提到以下風險：法律和監管風險、財務風險、產品風險、技術風險、供應鏈風險、稅務風險、市場風險等。公司的業務、結果、財務狀況和股票價格可能會受到各種因素的不利影響，包括法律和監管的變化、財務市場的波動、產品和服務的質量問題、技術的變化、供應鏈的中斷、稅務政策的變化和市場的波動 [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #57]。此外，公司還面臨著產品設計和製造缺陷的風險、第三方知識產權的風險、talent 和文化的風險 [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #48]。公司的全球供應鏈和分銷網絡也使其面臨著潛在的風險，包括與第三方供應商和經銷商相關的風險 [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #46]。市場風險包括股票價格的波動、投資的風險和全球經濟的變化 [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #58]。 

公司的業務結果和財務狀況可能會受到各種因素的不利影響，包括稅務政策的變化、財務市場的波動和市場的波動 [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]।此外，公司還需要面臨著與全球經營相關的風險，包括法律和監管的變化、財務市場的波動和市場的波動 [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #4]。

records.query: AAPL 202512 那一季的 10-Q 裡，營收成長主要來自哪些產品線？
records.answer:

records.query: NVIDIA Blackwell GPU architecture
records.answer: The NVIDIA Blackwell GPU architecture delivers a significant increase in token throughput and reduction in cost per token compared to the Hopper generation [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #38]. Introduced in fiscal year 2025, the Blackwell architecture is a full set of data center scale infrastructure that includes GPUs, CPUs, DPUs, interconnects, switch chips and systems, and networking adapters [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #42]. It excels at processing cutting edge generative AI and accelerated computing workloads with market leading performance and efficiency [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #42]. The Blackwell architecture also introduced neural graphics, which combines AI models with traditional rendering to boost game performance, image quality, and interactivity [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #43]. In fiscal year 2026, NVIDIA launched and scaled the Blackwell Ultra platform, optimized for agentic, reasoning, and physical AI [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #38]. The Blackwell architecture represented the majority of NVIDIA's Data Center revenue [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #115].

records.query: Jensen Huang NVIDIA CEO
records.answer: Jen-Hsun Huang, also known as Jensen Huang, has served as NVIDIA's President, Chief Executive Officer, and a member of the Board of Directors since the company's inception in 1993 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #58]. He co-founded NVIDIA in 1993 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #58] and is currently the CEO of the world's most valuable company, due to huge demand for its AI hardware [NVDA_News_20260519_03.txt, chunk #1]. As of February 20, 2026, he holds the position of President and Chief Executive Officer [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #26]. Huang recently traveled to China with US President Donald Trump and expects the Chinese market to open to high-end US chips that can train and run artificial intelligence systems over time [NVDA_News_20260519_03.txt, chunk #0]. He has stated that the Chinese government has to decide how much of their local market they want to protect, but his sense is that over time the market will open [NVDA_News_20260519_03.txt, chunk #1].

records.query: Tim Cook Apple CEO
records.answer: Tim Cook is the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of Apple Inc. [Reference 2: AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #27].
